# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old (11 on his birthday during Volume 2)  <sub>[v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** The United States (Boston)  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy / student at Brierley school  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric has a small, exquisite face with delicate features, dark blue eyes, crimson lips, and a halo of chestnut brown curls. Although ten years old when he arrives in Brierley, he appears to be eight at most, though he grows noticeably taller over his time there. He wears an elegant small fur cap and coat in winter.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c27 P23](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0023), [v2 c28 P9](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0009)_

## Personality

Cedric possesses a grave, sober, and meditative disposition, yet his face lights up with a warm, responsive smile when shown kindness. He has a rich imagination, creating invisible "rock people" and poetical ideas about nature, though he maintains a strong sense of fairness and natural manliness. Polished, thoughtful, and polite, he is deeply affectionate toward those he loves, while also showing periodic bursts of striking perception.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c8 P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c19 P32](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0032), [v2 c27 P54](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0054)_

## History

Cedric moves from the United States to Brierley to reside with his grandmother, Mrs. Stanhope. He enters Brierley school under Nell Harcourt's tutelage, immediately bonding with her over their shared imaginative spirit and mutual affection. At school, he proves to be an exceptionally bright, well-behaved student who also earns the respect of fellow boys by standing up for himself in fights and games. Nell often holds him up as an ideal example of good behavior, prompting jealousy and emulation from younger boys like Robin Farrow. On his eleventh birthday, he receives a framed portrait of his deceased mother from his father, which he places at the foot of his bed. Later, Nell introduces Cedric to Miss Rosalind Penrose, his father's former betrothed; the two form an immediate emotional connection. When Stephen Stanhope unexpectedly visits Brierley, Cedric introduces him to Nell and unwittingly helps bring about the romantic reunion of Stephen and Rosalind. At their garden wedding, Cedric enthusiastically rings a brass dinner bell to celebrate their marriage, after which it is arranged for him to move back to Boston with them in the autumn.

## Background by volume

- Born in the United States to Stephen Stanhope and a mother who died three years prior  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004), [v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036)</sub>
- Sent from Boston to Brierley to live with his paternal grandmother on the shore road  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
